'''K0-5D''', nicknamed '''Maximo''', was an [[ASP-series labor droid/Legends|ASP-series labor droid]] that was modified for gladiatorial droid combat by his owners, a band of [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. His arms were equipped with [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]] to scorch the droids he battled for the amusement of his owners. He was tasked with fighting [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] in an arena in the pirates' [[Starship/Legends|ship]] shortly after the two droids were captured on [[Balnab/Legends|Balnab]]. But before he could attack the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]], [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] blasted a hole in the hull of the ship, sucking K0-5D, the pirates, 3PO, R2-D2, and a few other droids into space to be captured by [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]].
